site.name: SSU WINE SPECTATOR CENTER — Campus Vineyard
geometry_notes: Anchored to the Wine Spectator Learning Center building as mapped in OpenStreetMap (way 362188591).

Bed outline traced from georeferenced aerial imagery (Esri World Imagery) and matched to the project team's screenshot: about 16 m × 7 m just south of the building, following the bed's uneven edge and rounded east end. The concrete pad at its north-west corner is excluded. Not surveyed (about ±1–2 m).
Three east–west vine rows, traced from the same imagery and screenshot.
Rows are divided into 2, 3 and 4 segments (north to south), evenly spaced as a starting point. Segment boundaries are not derived from vegetation density; adjust them in Options → Vineyard layout.
No sensors are confirmed at this plot; per-segment readings are synthetic examples.
